monthly_rent.line: Monthly rent is ₹22,000, payable in advance on or before the tenth day of each month.

security_deposit.line: The Tenant shall pay a refundable security deposit of ₹66,000, equal to three months of the stated monthly rent.

total_length.line: The tenancy commences on 1 November 2026 and ends on 31 October 2027.

tenant_can_leave_early.line: Either Party may request termination by written notice.

landlord_can_end_early.line: Either Party may request termination by written notice.

rent_increase.line: The monthly rent may increase by five percent if the building’s annual maintenance costs rise by more than ten percent
